verdict.rationale: Agora documents usage, quality and performance analytics and diagnostics, but nothing shows AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's own data inside the product. Its LLM, voice-agent and transcript features are building blocks developers use to construct their own apps, not in-product AI insights. Per the partial-credit rules, those adjacent features earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
